description: Create a water damage insurance claim inventory spreadsheet. You need to document at least 6 damaged household items from a burst pipe incident. Create a spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/water_damage_claim.xlsx with columns: Item Description, Location/Room, Damage Level, Purchase Date, and Estimated Value. Include items from at least 3 different rooms with a mix of damage levels (Total Loss, Partial, etc.). Add a SUM formula to calculate the total claim amount. Format headers and total as bold. Save the file (Ctrl+S).
